🚨A solo team just open sourced a system that lets AI agents actually LEARN over time instead of just recalling old chats — and it beats RAG.

Most agents dump chat history into a vector store and call it done. Hindsight is different: it gets smarter the more it's used, and it's already state-of-the-art on the LongMemEval benchmark.

One-line Docker install. Works with 25+ LLM providers, even fully local ones like Ollama.
